worldcombat.skill.torchsong.summary: Plant itself and sing out a sustained flame cone: the song sweeps the cone in several pulses, scorching every enemy inside again and again, and the first hit also raises the user's own Sp. Atk.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.use.0: Pin a foe at range with the flame cone
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.use.1: Wrap a whole row of foes in the cone
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.use.2: Open with a song to kindle its own Sp. Atk
Blow a flame cone ahead: the whole song deals about %1$s special damage, sung in %2$s pulses %3$s s apart. Each pulse sweeps the entire cone, so every enemy inside takes that pulse's share and a target that stays in the cone is scorched again, up to the whole song.

The cone reaches %1$s blocks and spans %2$s degrees; the user stands still for the whole song, and each pulse knocks a hit target %3$s blocks. The first time the song deals damage it raises the user's Sp. Atk by %4$s stage(s), at most once per cast.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.marcato.on: Marcato: a longer, wider, heavier song at the cost of staying put longer and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.marcato.off: Short cry: a brisk, shorter song, quicker to recover but with less coverage and less total.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: total damage %2$s, %3$s pulses, Sp. Atk +%4$s.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.preference.m: On: a longer, wider, heavier song, but standing still longer and a longer cooldown. Off: a brisk, shorter song with less coverage and less total.
worldcombat.skill.torchsong.preference.a: Only start singing when the foe is within this range; smaller sings up close, larger sings from far off.
Closer than this the companion will not rush a song (it still casts when it is the only option); larger keeps more distance.
